metadata.description: Isolated Prototype for Neck-Shoulder MSK Scenario with Verified Surface Registration
metadata.disclaimer: Experimental educational visualization. Clinical status: PENDING_QUALIFIED_HUMAN_EXPERT_REVIEW.

GV14.anchor_structure: Depression inferior to spinous process of 7th cervical vertebra (vertebra prominens)
GV14.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 235: Posterior midline, in the depression inferior to the spinous process of the 7th cervical vertebra (C7).
GV14.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
GV14.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
GV14.tuina_method: 拇指按揉或擦法至局部温热，外感初起常用，约 1–2 分钟。
GV14.location_zh: 在脊柱区，第7颈椎棘突下凹陷中，后正中线上。
GV14.location_method: 低头时颈后最高骨（第7颈椎）下方凹陷。
GV14.evidence_summary: 证据不足，不能替代规范治疗；喘息/呼吸困难需医疗评估。

GB21.anchor_structure: Midpoint between C7 spinous process and lateral extremity of acromion process, on m. trapezius
GB21.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 195: On the shoulder, at the midpoint of the line connecting the spinous process of C7 and the lateral extremity of the acromion.
GB21.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
GB21.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
cautions: 孕妇禁用（刺激较强，有引产顾虑）。
GB21.tuina_method: 拿捏法为主：拇指与其余四指对合提拿肩部肌肉，配合按揉，每侧 1–2 分钟。
GB21.location_zh: 在肩胛区，第7颈椎棘突与肩峰最外侧点连线的中点。
GB21.location_method: 大椎与肩峰连线中点，肩部最高肌肉处。
GB21.evidence_summary: 针刺与手法治疗对慢性颈痛有中等程度短期获益(个体患者数据 Meta 分析纳入颈痛)；推拿/按压松解肌筋膜机制清晰，但高质量证据有限。
citations: Vickers AJ, et al. 针刺治疗慢性疼痛(含颈痛) IPD Meta 分析. J Pain 2018;19(5):455-474.

GB20.anchor_structure: Suboccipital depression between upper portion of m. sternocleidomastoideus and m. trapezius
GB20.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 194: In the anterior region of the neck, inferior to the occipital bone, in the depression between m. sternocleidomastoideus and m. trapezius.
GB20.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
GB20.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
GB20.tuina_method: 拇指按揉或双手抱头以拇指顶按两侧凹陷，向上方用力，每次 1–2 分钟。
GB20.location_zh: 在颈后区，枕骨之下，胸锁乳突肌上端与斜方肌上端之间的凹陷中。
GB20.location_method: 后发际两侧，两条大筋外缘凹陷，与耳垂大致平齐。
GB20.evidence_summary: 针刺对紧张型头痛与偏头痛预防有 Cochrane 支持(优于假针/常规护理，效应中等)；穴位按压自身证据较弱但机制合理。
citations: Linde K, et al. 针刺预防紧张型头痛. Cochrane 2016;(4):CD007587.
Linde K, et al. 针刺预防偏头痛. Cochrane 2016;(6):CD001218.
Vickers AJ, et al.(Acupuncture Trialists' Collaboration). 针刺治疗慢性疼痛 IPD Meta 分析. J Pain 2018;19(5):455-474.

BL10.anchor_structure: Lateral margin of m. trapezius at level of C2 vertebra
BL10.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 116: In the posterior region of the neck, level with the superior border of the spinous process of C2, in the depression on the lateral border of m. trapezius.
BL10.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
BL10.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
BL10.tuina_method: 拇指按揉后发际两侧大筋外缘，头痛/落枕常用，每侧 1–2 分钟。
BL10.location_zh: 在颈后区，横平第2颈椎棘突上际，斜方肌外缘凹陷中。
BL10.location_method: 后发际正中旁开约1.3寸，项部两条大筋（斜方肌）外缘凹陷处。
BL10.evidence_summary: 针刺对紧张型头痛与偏头痛预防有 Cochrane 支持(优于假针/常规护理，效应中等)；穴位按压自身证据较弱但机制合理。
citations: Linde K, et al. 针刺预防紧张型头痛. Cochrane 2016;(4):CD007587.
Linde K, et al. 针刺预防偏头痛. Cochrane 2016;(6):CD001218.
Vickers AJ, et al.(Acupuncture Trialists' Collaboration). 针刺治疗慢性疼痛 IPD Meta 分析. J Pain 2018;19(5):455-474.

SI15.anchor_structure: 2 cun lateral to lower border of C7 spinous process, medial border of scapula
SI15.fma_id: FMA:13337 (Seventh cervical vertebra) & FMA:23215 (Spine of scapula)
SI15.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 109: Upper back, 2 B-cun lateral to the posterior midline, level with the lower border of C7 spinous process.
SI15.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
SI15.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
functions: 主咳嗽，氣喘，吐血，肩背痛，目視不明。
indications: 支氣管炎、哮喘、咯血、肩背痛、視力模糊。
SI15.tuina_method: 指腹轻柔按揉 1-2 分钟，力度均匀。
SI15.location_method: 第七頸椎（大椎）旁開2寸，肩胛骨內側緣上端。
SI15.evidence_summary: 传统经络穴位教学模型，临床操作须经专业医师指导。

TE15.anchor_structure: Superior angle of scapula / supraspinous fossa
TE15.fma_id: FMA:23215 (Supraspinous fossa) & FMA:24285 (Superior angle of scapula)
TE15.who_standard: WHO Standard 2008, p. 182: Scapular region, in the supraspinous fossa, midway between GB21 and SI13, on the superior angle of the scapula.
TE15.verification_notes: Calibrated to authentic BodyParts3D softened skin mesh (0.00mm surface error, face matched).
TE15.source_provenance: BodyParts3D FJ2810 Skin Mesh + JICio Baked Surface Topology
functions: 主肩臂痠痛，頸項強急，胸中煩滿，缺盆中痛，寒熱，瘰癧，偏風。
indications: 肩臂痠痛、頸部肌肉痙攣、胸悶、鎖骨上窩疼痛、瘧疾寒熱、頸淋巴結核、顏面神經麻痺。
TE15.tuina_method: 指腹轻柔按揉 1-2 分钟，力度均匀。
TE15.location_zh: 肩缺盆中，直天牖旁一寸。
TE15.location_method: 肩井穴後約1寸，與大椎、肩峰連線中點。
TE15.evidence_summary: 传统经络穴位教学模型，临床操作须经专业医师指导。
